name: andrew-code-review
description: Evidence-based code reviews with explicit coverage and provider-independent execution.

scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test docs README.md AGENTS.md package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json .prettierrc.json .andrew-review.example.yml
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run format:check
